name: smartestate
description: SmartEstate — AI-assisted apartment search and buying advisor for the Armenian real-estate market (thesis project).

scripts.check: turbo run lint typecheck test build
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose up -d --build --wait
scripts.ml:test: docker build --target test -t smartestate-ml-test apps/ml && docker run --rm smartestate-ml-test
scripts.ml:lint: docker build --target test -t smartestate-ml-test apps/ml && docker run --rm smartestate-ml-test ruff check . && docker run --rm smartestate-ml-test ruff format --check .
scripts.ml:train: docker build --target train -t smartestate-ml-train apps/ml && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/apps/ml/app/models:/srv/app/models" -v "$PWD/docs:/docs" -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://smartestate:smartestate@host.docker.internal:5432/smartestate smartestate-ml-train --report /docs/thesis/evaluation.md
